Teachers · trainers · in French

Teaching progression planner

Your units, their objectives and planned hours laid on your real school calendar: holidays you enter for your area, public holidays computed every year, each class's weekly slots (week A and week B included). After each lesson, one tap (done, postponed or cancelled) updates progress against plan, the delay in hours and lessons, and the projected end date, with an alert when the syllabus will not fit before the last lesson. A timeline with target windows, a bank of objective verbs sorted by the six levels of Bloom's revised taxonomy, a printable lesson log, CSV export and next year's copy. No pupil data, no official syllabus included.
